items.content:
Dear Pathfinders,

Hello everyone! Since Aniimo launched, we’ve been blown away by your love and support. Thank you so much for stepping into Idyll and setting out on this adventure with us. Every hour you play and every kind word you share is what motivates us to keep going.

At the same time, we’ve seen plenty of honest feedback and complaints. Every suggestion, complaint, and question you post on social media, in comment sections, and in community is read and reviewed by our dev team. To us, such feedback shows that you genuinely love Aniimo and want it to get better.

Every so often, we’ll round up the issues you care about and talk about most, and share with you what we think, what we’re changing, and what’s coming next. Here are the top issues this time, along with our progress and plans:

1. Rerolling the same Aniimo keeps giving repeat colors and burns through resources. Can this be improved?

In version 1.1, we’re improving Sparkling Hue rerolls for Sparkling Prismana Aniimo. Once it’s live, you’ll be able to freely switch between any Sparkling Hue you’ve already unlocked for an Aniimo.

2. Some Aniimo already look great in their original Prismana colors. After using a Sparkling Cube, can I keep the original color?

After the version 1.1 update, you’ll be able to switch between all the Sparkling Hue styles unlocked for that Prismana Aniimo, including its original Prismana Hue, so you can switch back any time.

3. Why does my Legendary Irisalis have 88 Potential when someone else’s has 99?

We’ve read through all your feedback. Right now, Irisalis’s Innate Potential is random. Since you can only get this Legendary Aniimo once, having random Potential means the payoff isn’t guaranteed for this rare Aniimo. That’s not the experience we want for you.

So after the version 1.1 update, we’re removing Irisalis’s random Innate Potential and setting it to fixed values: ATK: 10, REGEN: 10, HP: 5, BREAK: 5, M.DEF: 5, P.DEF: 5

Any existing Potential above these values will be converted into Starcryst Essence as compensation. Watch for the version update announcement and in-game mail for the exact conversion rules and amounts.

4. Can I switch a Sparkling Aniimo I already own to a Legendary Aniipod’s exclusive Sparkling effect?

After the version 1.1 update, Legendary Aniipods can be used on Sparkling Aniimo. This replaces the Aniipod it was originally caught with and grants that Legendary Aniipod’s exclusive Sparkling effect.

5. Are there plans to fix lag and overheating on mobile?

We’ve received a lot of feedback on this. A dedicated team is optimizing for popular devices right now to reduce lag and overheating and improve the mobile experience as soon as possible.

6. Support tickets take a long time to get a reply. Can this be faster?

We’re continuing to improve how support works, including upgrading the support system, growing the team, and streamlining internal handoffs so that tickets get answered and resolved faster. Some complex issues require checking account data and working across several teams to find the cause, so they may take longer, but we’ll keep improving. Thank you for your patience and understanding.

7. My Steam/Console account failed to link. What should I do?

Please log in to our Customer Support page.

Under Quick Support Links, click Account Issues. Then select Steam Relink (PSN/Xbox) for both the second-level and third-level categories.

Please submit a support ticket with the following information:

- The platform ID you would like to unlink (e.g., Steam ID)

- The UID you are currently using to contact Customer Support, along with the email address linked to it

- The UID you would like to unlink

- The platform currently linked to the UID you would like to unlink

We will review your request and process it as soon as possible.

We’ll keep reviewing your real experiences and suggestions, and share bug fixes, improvements, mechanic changes, and future plans openly. We’d love to hear more of your feedback, too.

Thank you again to every Pathfinder for your patience and honest feedback. Every message you leave motivates us to keep improving. Have fun and enjoy your time in Idyll!

The Aniimo Dev Team

items.content:
Dear Pathfinders,

Polaris Institute released a resource update on September 30, 2026, without server downtime. Please restart your game client to download the latest resources.

Pathfinders, please see below for a summary of this update.

Update Schedule

\ September 30, 2026

\ Glimmer ×100

\ Pathfinders who registered before the version 1.1 update

September 30: New Appearances in the Shop

Limited-Edition Appearance: Forest of Butterfly Dreams

Butterfly shadows flit through the shadowed woods, weaving yet another sweet dream.

Appearance Set: Frostburst Punk

Shatter the silence, unleash a defiant rock-and-roll soul.

Visit Shop > Recommended to purchase the new Frostburst Punk set for 680 Lumin Crystals.

Experience Improvements

1. Updated the item acquisition notification icon for Legendary Aniipod: Irisalis.

2. Updated the showcase video and image for Legendary Aniipod: Departure with the Wind to match its actual in-game effects.

3. Increased the number of Transmogrification Presets available for Irisalis from 3 to 5.

4. Improved the controller experience when claiming progress bar rewards.

5. Added a deselection prompt when exiting Catch Mode with a Special Aniipod selected.

6. Improved performance when logging in and switching scenes.

7. Adjusted the unlock condition for the outfit-dyeing achievement so that it can now be unlocked by adding one friend.

Bug Fixes

\

1. Fixed an issue where some of Irisalis's model textures became blurry after using Transmog to switch to styles from the Starbloom Moonlight or Sunflare Rose sets.

2. Fixed an issue where some model textures on Grizbo, Luminelle, and Sherro became blurry.

3. Fixed an issue with skill effects when Irisalis was equipped with its exclusive Held Item, Floral Rainbow Feather.

4. Fixed an issue where some Aniimo sank into the ground.

5. Fixed an issue where accessories displayed incorrectly when placed on Thornblade's weapon.

6. Fixed an issue where the view and gift shortcuts conflicted when gifting Aniimo.

7. Fixed an issue where incorrect text was displayed when Sparkling Pigment could not be used.

8. Fixed an issue where the button combination for exiting flight did not work.

9. Fixed an issue where Aniimo models were not displayed when viewing their details.

10. Fixed an issue with the exchange panel when exchanging Umbral Aniimo.

\

1. Fixed a rare issue where the Umbral Stellarys Alpha's immunity to control effects did not work correctly in Operation: Egg Heist.

2. Fixed an issue in Operation: Egg Heist where the outer island occasionally had no Sanctum entrance.

3. Added Erlath, an enemy with group support abilities. Pathfinders are advised to prioritize defeating it when encountered.

4. Increased Stellarys's Starine drop rate on Chaos difficulty.

\

1. Fixed an issue where joining a friend's party via "Come to My World" early in the game could block progression.

2. Fixed an issue where some Hummin could not be brought back during the "Family Reunion" quest.

3. Fixed an issue in Russet Highlands where Pathfinders could not speak to the elder Rookey to claim their reward after completing all activities involving the lost Helmut.

4. Fixed a rare interaction failure that could block quest progress when retrieving the Vine Core during a side quest in Mistwoods.

5. Fixed a rare issue where disconnecting during a cutscene in the "A New Journey" main quest could prevent further progress.

\

1. Fixed an issue where the bridge in the construction area disappeared when visiting another Pathfinder's Home.

2. Fixed an issue where Energizing Work Meal could not be used while producing Quick Recipe: Fresh Water in Home.

3. Fixed an issue where some furniture items were sorted incorrectly in the furniture list.

4. Fixed an issue where Rock - Repose could not be purchased from the Furniture Store.

5. Fixed an issue where appearance backgrounds were missing from Aniimo Management in Home.

6. Fixed an issue where the notification shown after an Aniimo trip at the Park led to the wrong screen.

7. Fixed an issue where the reward progress bar in the Home Index was positioned incorrectly.

8. Fixed an issue where Season Orders were missing their order badges.

9. Reduced the Harvest Moon Point collection requirements in the Home Season event.

10. Fixed an issue where models disappeared while playing in Home on certain mobile operating systems.

\

1. Fixed an issue where Sparkling Aniimo could not be selected with a controller in Aniimo Management.

2. Fixed an issue where certain button inputs conflicted in Companion Mode.

3. Fixed a rare teleportation issue that caused scenes to load incorrectly. Pathfinders who encounter this issue can go to the Outpost and use the green interaction point to reload the correct scene.

4. Fixed an issue where outfits displayed incorrectly after entering Snap Mode while seated, using a photo emote, and then exiting Snap Mode.

5. Fixed an issue where target lock could not be released in certain situations.

6. Fixed an issue where treasure chest markers were visible but the rewards could not be claimed.

7. Fixed an issue where red reward notification dots in the Aniilog could not be cleared in certain situations.

8. Fixed an issue where photos serving as proof of research could be deleted from the Album.

9. Fixed an issue where an unsaved changes warning still appeared when exiting the Photo Studio after saving.

10. Fixed an issue where the Osmanthus Moon Lantern character accessory was positioned incorrectly.

\

1. Fixed an issue where the "Windchaser: Gold" achievement could not be unlocked.

2. Fixed a rare issue where the game could freeze when bringing a Prismana Fulmintis along.

3. Fixed an issue that caused stuttering when opening the Album on PlayStation.

4. Fixed an issue where the "Safe and Sound" and "Friends in Focus" achievements could not be unlocked.

5. Fixed a crash that could occur when removing certain accessories during preview.

— Polaris Institute Operations Team

Dear Pathfinders,

All Aniimo servers are now live! Thank you for your patience and understanding during the service maintenance.

As compensation, we will provide the following:

Service Maintenance Compensation

  • 500 Glimmers — original maintenance compensation

    [/*]

  • 500 Glimmers — additional compensation for the delayed launch

    [/*]

Known Issue Compensation

  • 1 Sparkling Cube

    [/*]

Please note that the in-game mailbox is currently unavailable, so the compensation will be sent in two separate in-game mails once the mailbox function is restored:

  • Mail 1: 1,000 Glimmers — Service Maintenance Compensation

    [/*]

  • Mail 2: 1 Sparkling Cube — Known Issue Compensation

    [/*]

We appreciate your patience while we work to resolve this issue. Thank you for your continued support and understanding!

Dear Pathfinders,

When the wind rises, it beckons a new Departure. Your journey across the continent of Idyll starts here and now.

Polaris Institute is scheduled to undergo server maintenance for an update from September 23, 2026, 00:00 to 10:00 UTC. Following this update, the game will officially launch globally on mobile platforms. Servers will be offline during this period, so please plan your adventures accordingly.

Here is a summary of the incoming updates for your reference:

>Maintenance Schedule

\

「Aniimo-Europe」2026/09/22 16:00 - 2026/09/23 02:00 UTC

「Aniimo-Americas」2026/09/22 12:00 - 22:00 UTC-4

「Aniimo-Apac」2026/09/23 00:00 - 10:00 UTC+8

\: Glimmer x500

\: All Pathfinders registered prior to the version 1.1 update.

* Actual maintenance duration may vary based on progress. We appreciate your patience and understanding. Once maintenance is complete, please restart your game client to ensure you're on the latest build.

>New Content Preview

Legendary Journey: Windchaser's Departure—New Stage Unlocked

Legendary Aniimo ""Irisalis"" Debuts

Legend has it that Irisalis blooms amidst radiant colors, gathering the world's hues to breathe life and vigor into the land. Pathfinder, follow the drifting petals on the breeze and seek out its presence.

\

「Aniimo-Europe」2026/09/25 10:00 - 2026/12/09 23:59 UTC

「Aniimo-Americas」2026/09/25 10:00 - 2026/12/09 19:59 UTC-4

「Aniimo-Apac」2026/09/25 10:00 - 2026/12/10 07:59 UTC+8

\

Level reaches Student I.

\

Legendary Journey: Windchaser's Departure—Iris Companion

A new weekly-limited source for Iris Petals has been introduced. Spend a required number of Iris Petals to craft the Legendary Aniipod: Irisalis.

Once successfully crafted, the cube unlocks the Rift Space where Irisalis resides. Forge your Twine to unlock the Blessing Gifts.

After befriending Irisalis, you will also unlock its exclusive Transmog ability.

Legendary Journey: Windchaser's Departure—Blessing Gifts

During the Windchaser's Departure season, after crafting the Legendary Aniipod: Irisalis, you can spend a certain number of Iris Petals to craft the Legendary Aniipod: Windchaser's Departure.

Using the Legendary Aniipod: Windchaser's Departure guarantees a 100% capture rate. The captured Aniimo is guaranteed to possess the Perfect Innate Potential, appear in its Sparkling Form, and carry exclusive seasonal perks for Windchaser's Departure.

Gameplay Updates

Holo-Battle Interlink

\

Every week from Thursday 04:00 to Monday 03:59 post-update.

\

Character reaches Trailblazer I.

\

Developed by the Battle Art, Holo-Battle Interlink uses advanced simulation technology to recreate Alpha encounters based on historical data of high-threat Aniimos. Form a 4-player team or match with AI teammates to take on the challenge.

In each cycle, you can challenge three distinct routes, each featuring unique Alphas and environmental mechanics. Customize your Aniimo lineup and select buff effects prior to battle (selected by the Team Leader in 4-player co-op).

All routes can be replayed freely. The system tracks your highest Star Rank for each route independently, unlocking milestone rewards based on your combined Star total across all three routes. Assisting fellow Pathfinders in improving their Star Ranks also grants Support Rewards. Both Star Rank Rewards and Support Rewards reset weekly.

Operation: Egg Heist Team Mode—Chaos Mode

\

「Aniimo-Europe」Unlocks on 2026/09/24 04:00 UTC

「Aniimo-Americas」Unlocks on 2026/09/24 04:00 UTC-4

「Aniimo-Apac」Unlocks on 2026/09/24 04:00 UTC+8

\

Reach Tier IV "Elite Egg Seeker" in Operation: Egg Heist.

\

This is the pinnacle difficulty mode, requiring a Chaos Ticket for entry. It features significantly higher drop rates for Prismana Aniimo Eggs and Prismatic Collectibles, alongside opportunities to discover ultra-rare Secret Collectibles. However, Chaos Mode is fraught with peril and enforces strict escape conditions. Teaming up is highly recommended.

New Events Available

Glamour Star

\

「Aniimo-Europe」2026/09/25 04:00 - 2026/10/02 03:59 UTC

「Aniimo-Americas」2026/09/25 04:00 - 2026/10/02 03:59 UTC-4

「Aniimo-Apac」2026/09/25 04:00 - 2026/10/02 03:59 UTC+8

\

Character reaches Student II.

\

Audition Theme: Floral Soirée.

Select a suitable Aniimo and accessorize it to fit the theme before submitting your entry. The Institute will score your Aniimo based on how well the Aniimo and its accessories match the current theme. Reach specific score milestones to claim corresponding rewards.

Aniimo Discovery

\

「Aniimo-Europe」2026/09/25 04:00 - 2026/10/09 03:59 UTC

「Aniimo-Americas」2026/09/25 04:00 - 2026/10/09 03:59 UTC-4

「Aniimo-Apac」2026/09/25 04:00 - 2026/10/09 03:59 UTC+8

\

Character reaches Student II.

\

Polaris Institute has sighted a brand-new Aniimo across Idyll and needs your help conducting field research.

Spend Search Attempts to track and capture it across the continent. Free Search Attempts will be replenished periodically by the Institute. Note that unspent free attempts do not stack, so be sure to use them promptly.

If you run out of free attempts, you can spend Vein Essence to continue searching.

Complete research quests tied to this Aniimo to earn rich rewards. As your research progress advances, you'll also unlock various Search Buffs at the Research Center.

Vein Abundance

\

Vein Abundance: Rosetower Woods

「Aniimo-Europe」2026/09/28 04:00 - 2026/10/05 03:59 UTC

「Aniimo-Americas」2026/09/28 04:00 - 2026/10/05 03:59 UTC-4

「Aniimo-Apac」2026/09/28 04:00 - 2026/10/05 03:59 UTC+8

Vein Abundance: Berylline Vale

「Aniimo-Europe」2026/10/05 04:00 - 2026/10/12 03:59 UTC

「Aniimo-Americas」2026/10/05 04:00 - 2026/10/12 03:59 UTC-4

「Aniimo-Apac」2026/10/05 04:00 - 2026/10/12 03:59 UTC+8

\

Character reaches Student II.

\

Drawn by surges in Vein energy, special Prismana Form Aniimos will spawn in designated regions for a limited time. The schedules and locations are as follows:

2026/09/28 04:00 - 2026/10/05 03:59: Prismana Form Melloblum appears at Rosetower Woods.

2026/10/05 04:00 - 2026/10/12 03:59: Prismana Form Waleetle appears at Berylline Vale.

Journey Chronicles

\

「Aniimo-Europe」2026/10/01 04:00 - 2026/10/29 03:59 UTC

「Aniimo-Americas」2026/10/01 04:00 - 2026/10/29 03:59 UTC-4

「Aniimo-Apac」2026/10/01 04:00 - 2026/10/29 03:59 UTC+8

\

Character reaches Student I.

\

Every encounter along the way is a memory worth treasuring. Log in for a specified number of days during the event to claim travel gifts and capture unforgettable moments with your Aniimos!

New Appearance

Appearance Set: Radiant Waveglow

Sway with the tides and glow with radiant brilliance.

Head over to Shop - Featured to purchase the new Radiant Waveglow set for 980 Lumin Crystals.

Accessory & Furniture Pack: Laurel Moon Blessing

When the moon climbs the branches, sweet laurel scents fill the air—a gentle gift from a moonlit night.

Head over to Shop - Featured to purchase the pack for 280 Lumin Crystals, which includes: Furniture ""Floral Moon Jukebox"" x1, Accessory ""Laurel Lantern"" x1, and Accessory ""Moonbound Journey"" x1.

>Quality-of-Life Optimizations

Story Experience

1. Added a new option "Pathfinder Voice" in Settings - Sound Settings - Volume Balance, used to control the playback settings for Pathfinder voice in game story.

2. The quest series name for Title Promotion Assessment has been uniformly changed to Promotion Series, making it easier for Pathfinders to identify and search.

3. Adjusted the quest objective descriptions for a small number of Elite Training Plan quests to make them clearer and more aligned with actual requirements.

Home System

1. Added direct shortcuts to the Home Shop and Co-op Store within the General Service Area section of Home Management.

2. Added an E-Mode toggle switch in Facility Management under the Production Area section of Home Management.

3. Improved the visual indicator display for Snap Points when using Build Snapping.

4. Enhanced controller navigation across several interfaces, including Home Layouts, Home Index, Park Buffs, Home Season Lunar Crops, and Building Controls.

5. Upgraded art assets for select furniture pieces, fixing collision, model height, and texture alignment issues.

6. Added a new level-up reward "Mysterious Prismana Egg" at "Home" levels 15 and 18.

System & Features

1. Temporarily hidden unobtained Sparkling Forms in Aniilog. A future update will re-enable previewing unobtained Sparkling Forms.

2. Added access to the Branch interface directly from Outpost.

3. Improved resource cost displays on the Appearance Design interface.

4. Refined warning prompts for conflicting outfit pieces.

5. Equipping specific outfit sets now activates Affinity Abilities between your character and designated Aniimos.

6. Streamlined the Companion Mode, allowing you to invite friends on a Companion without needing to stand face-to-face in-game.

7. Standardized the interaction entry points for initiating and ending Companions.

8. Improved gathering mechanics during Companions: when any player gathers a rare resource, it is now shared with all party members in the Companion state.

9. Polished character poses and animations for Friendship Tree Affinity photos.

10. Upgraded Voice-to-Text translation: detecting foreign speech now automatically transcribes and translates it into your language.

11. Enhanced interactive messaging: tapping a Pathfinder's avatar now directly opens their interaction panel.

12. Extended the bloom duration of Blooms from 2 minutes to 3 minutes.

13. Increased the single-purchase quantity limit in the Shop from 99 to 100.

Performance & Bug Fixes

1. Fixed an issue causing screen discoloration (red tinting) on certain devices.

2. Fixed localized rendering blackouts occurring on specific GPU models.

3. Resolved an issue where the client could enter an infinite reconnection loop under certain circumstances.

4. Optimized rendering performance for target-locking indicators and floating damage numbers.

5. Reduced UI-related stuttering for a smoother navigation experience.

6. Optimized memory management and performance overhead for select environmental assets.

7. Slightly increased the animation frame rate on PC.

Console/Controller-Specific Experience Optimization

1. Optimized combo key operations to prevent accidentally opening the emote bar during combat.

2. Added an operation tip "Long-press Y to open the radial menu" to the Settings system.

3. Adjusted some buttons in the event interface to trigger on long press.

4. Adjusted the "Nurture" button to trigger on tap.

5. Adjusted the help system pop-up to be entered by long-pressing the Option button.

6. Optimized the alignment display of quest bar icons and button prompts.

7. Fixed an issue where players could not navigate to the skin selection option when using a controller.

8. Fixed an issue where gradient colors could not be selected in the appearance interface.

9. Fixed an issue where the soft keyboard could not be brought up when entering a face customization code.

10. Fixed an issue where the soft keyboard could not be brought up when naming the "RV", and the name could not be changed when first seeing the Home RV.

11. Fixed an issue where the game incorrectly prompted that the controller was disconnected and the prompt window could not be closed.

12. Fixed an audio abnormality after returning to the game using Quick Resume.

13. Fixed an issue where Aniimo custom videos did not play on PS5.

14. Fixed an issue on Xbox where the game froze when opening the chat interface and sending text messages.

Other Experience Optimizations

1. The "Inherit" button is prominently displayed in the info interface for Pathfinders' convenience.

2. Optimized the icons and descriptions of Elite Training Plan Bonded Held Items.

3. Optimized the feedback prompt when Pathfinders' "Windborn Stamp" and "Voxel Coin" reach the acquisition cap.

>Bug Fixes

1. Fixed an issue where the core effect of the held item "Echoing Grimoire" triggered abnormally, so that the actual effect is consistent with the description.

2. Fixed an issue where the "Helion" model rarely disappeared in story cutscenes.

3. Fixed an issue in the journey quest "A Fragrant Dream" where two interactions were required to complete the quest.

4. Fixed an issue in "Pathfinder Challenge" where damage loss occasionally occurred after knocking enemies airborne.

5. Fixed an issue in "Pathfinder Challenge" where players were occasionally knocked outside the invisible wall.

6. Fixed an issue in "Pathfinder Challenge" where the invisible wall occasionally did not disappear.

7. Fixed an issue in "Pathfinder Challenge" where some Aniimo owners' names were incorrect.

8. Fixed an issue with abnormal model display for "Helmut".

9. Fixed an issue with abnormal model display for "Flamerion" after being revived from the fainted state.

10. Fixed an issue where, after "Blazen" entered the Overcharged state, switching to another Aniimo to release skills could not restore Ultimate Points.

11. Fixed an issue where players occasionally got stuck inside walls when entering and exiting climbing.

12. Fixed an issue in "Twine Mode" where sprinting on the beach did not leave footprints.

13. Fixed an issue where abnormal actions occurred after opening the "Menu" while the character was in the fainted state.

14. Fixed an issue in the "Sanctum" where restarting the client during the black screen of character fainting caused the character to get stuck.

15. Fixed an issue where screen flickering could occur when skipping story.

16. Fixed an issue where level 10 orders were incorrectly generated at "Home" level 9; order levels now correctly match "Home" level.

Dear Pathfinders,

To provide a better experience, Polaris Institute will continue to improve the game and address any issues identified. The fixes included in this update are as follows:

>>Bug Fixes

1. Fixed an issue where the active Aniimo had a small chance of failing to Revive properly after fainted multiple times in a Sanctum. If Pathfinders still encounter this issue, exiting and re-entering the current scene can fix.

2. Fixed an issue where Catch results could not be processed correctly.

3. Fixed an issue where the hatching conditions for "Bond Eggs" did not match their descriptions.

4. Fixed an issue where Pathfinder using non-ATK Skills would trigger Aniimo ATK.

5. Fixed an issue where Bloom in "Zephyrus Landbridge" were linked to the wrong Aniimo Family.

6. Fixed an issue where Shrubclaw could disappear during the cave activity in Argent Strait.

7. Fixed an issue where NPCs could disappear during interaction, preventing Pathfinders from proceeding.

8. Fixed an issue where Pathfinder voice lines could overlap.

9. Fixed an issue where "Daily Activity" mail rewards were displayed incorrectly when resent.

10. Fixed an issue where Accessory adjustments were not saved after swapping slots.

11. Fixed an issue where designated Aniimo were not refreshed after using Nurture Offerings to Nurture Veins in certain Areas.

12. Fixed an issue where hair could appear stretched during initial character customization.

>>Optimizations & Adjustments

1. Optimized the icons and descriptions of Held Items in "Elite Training".

2. Optimized the display of "Mark Sharing". When "Mark Sharing" is near other interactable targets, its entry will be automatically hidden from the interaction List. To interact with "Mark Sharing", move away from other interactable targets.

3. Adjusted rules displayed on "Aniimo Exchange".

items.content:
Dear Pathfinders,

Here is a summary of the currently known game issues. Polaris Institute is actively working to resolve them. Please take note of the following:

1. Some visual effects may display abnormally when entering Astra for the first time.

2. Some Pathfinders may experience a red screen display issue in-game. As a temporary workaround, try switching the graphics quality to Performance Mode in Settings. This issue is expected to be fixed in future updates.

>> Additional Information

If a black screen occurs, please try the following:

1. Update the graphics driver.

2. Try switching between DX11 and DX12.

3. Disable DLSS and Frame Generation on the login screen.

To provide a better experience, Polaris Institute will continue to improve the game and address any issues identified. The fixes included in this update are as follows:

>>Bug Fixes

1. Fixed an issue where some Pathfinders could experience a red screen display issue in-game.

2. Fixed an issue where characters' eyes appeared abnormally red on certain graphics cards.

3. Fixed issues with Quick Twine and multiple forms being unable to participate in the Susuta and Dr. Glass challenges.

4. Fixed an issue where item source text in the Stamp Shop was incorrect.

5.Fixed an issue where certain terrain could occasionally become impassable while collecting Butterfly Shadows during the Story quest "The Land Where Dreams Come True," preventing quest progress.

6. Fixed an issue where the button for the "Star Pop-Up, Spud Squad Assemble" event displayed abnormally when hovered over with the mouse.

7. Fixed an issue where text in some shared marks displayed abnormally.

8. Fixed an issue where Companion Handbook EXP was not displayed properly on the Monthly Pass make-up check-in reward screen.

9. Fixed an issue where some Home formulas had incorrect values.

10. Fixed an issue where crossover event decorations in Astra were floating in midair.

11. Fixed an issue where chimney wind fields in Nimbus Fields displayed abnormally.

12. Fixed an issue with incorrect asset references in quest cutscenes.

13. Fixed an issue where interface text overlapped in one location during the Story quest "Another Departure."

14. Fixed an issue where an objective description was incorrect during the Story quest "Another Departure."

15.Fixed an issue where the description of the Pathfinder's Aeroboard skill was inaccurate.

16. Fixed an issue where using Unstuck while interacting with a two-player mechanism in a two-player Sanctum could cause players to become stuck.

17. Fixed an issue with incorrect punctuation in the Mysterious Vendor's dialogue.

>>Optimizations & Adjustments

1. Changed "Auto Voice" to be disabled by default in the settings at the bottom left of the chat interface. You can enable it as needed.

2. Optimized the spawn rules for Prismana Aniimo. When a Lucky Strike fills Prismatic Energy to maximum, Prismana Aniimo in the area can now respawn immediately.

3. Adjusted the locations of some chests that could not be claimed.

4. Reduced the default number of marks shared by strangers displayed in Settings. For existing characters, this can be adjusted manually in Settings.

5. Changed the type of item consumed to evolve Squarrel.

6. Optimized the conditions for obtaining Tilling Chest.

7. Removed error notification mail for common Aniipods to reduce notification disruptions. The actual items returned are unaffected.

items.content:
Dear Pathfinders,

Here is a summary of the currently known game issues. The Polaris Institute is actively working to resolve them. Please take note of the following:

1. Sealed Eggs from the Closed Beta claimed through the Bonded Promise Event have an issue with their Innate Potential data. The related claim entry has been temporarily closed and will reopen once the issue is fixed.

2. Some visual effects may display abnormally when entering Astra for the first time.

>> Additional Information

If a black screen occurs, please try the following:

1. Update the graphics driver

2. Try switching between DX11 and DX12.

3. Disable DLSS and Frame Generation on the login screen.

Steam controller not working

Please go to your Aniimo game page in your Steam Library → Manage → Properties → Controller, and switch it to "Disable Steam Input," then restart the game.

To provide a better experience, Polaris Institute will continue to improve the game and address any issues identified. The fixes included in this update are as follows:

>>Bug Fixes

1. Fixed an issue where some Pathfinders may experience abnormal damage values during combat.

2. Fixed an issue where the interface may have displayed abnormally when entering Home.

3. Fixed an issue where some Pathfinders may have experienced repeated disconnections and reconnections during client lag.

4. Fixed an issue where "Prismatic Kite Flowers" were not properly counted under certain conditions.

5. Fixed an issue where incorrect prompt messages were shown when the "Home" season feature had not reached the required level to unlock.

6. Fixed a black screen issue when returning to "Design Workshop" from the Shop interface.

7. Fixed an issue where the like-related buttons disappeared on the photo interface.

8. Fixed occasional Abnormal Status operations during the "Aniimo Management" tutorial.

9. Fixed an issue where certain items purchased on Xbox and Xbox PC were not delivered properly.

10. Fixed a series of line break errors, text truncation, and layout Abnormal Status issues in certain interface texts across multiple language versions, including German, French, Russian, Spanish, and Japanese.

>>Optimizations & Adjustments

1. Improved the item quality of "Gift of Encounter."

2. Optimized the gifting rewards and feature descriptions for "Gift of Affection" and "Gift of Celebration."

——The Polaris Institute Team

items.title: A Letter from the Aniimo Dev Team
items.summary: Hello everyone, we’re the development team behind Aniimo, Pawprint Studio. It’s been an honor, over the past year and beyond, to share Aniimo’s first reveal and the three tests that followed with all of you. From our first meeting to every
items.content:
Hello everyone, we’re the development team behind Aniimo, Pawprint Studio.

It’s been an honor, over the past year and beyond, to share Aniimo’s first reveal and the three tests that followed with all of you. From our first meeting to every encounter across each test, we’ve heard a lot of love, and plenty of honest frustration too. Thank you, truly, for taking the time to tell us what Aniimo looks like through your eyes, and for your support and patience all this way. Today, we’d like to make it official once more: Aniimo launches worldwide on PC, console, and Xbox cloud gaming on September 16, with the mobile version arriving September 23. We are all super stoked to finally get to meet you in Idyll!

Why Does Aniimo Exist?

Over the past year, one question has come up again and again from media and players alike: why make a game like Aniimo at all? The answer is actually pretty simple. Before we were developers, we were players. Like so many of you, we grew up on creature-collecting games, and we fell in love with the companions that stayed by our side through them. We’ve all trekked halfaway across game world just to meet one creature we adored. We’ve all had a chance encounter that kept us smiling for days. And somewhere in the back of our minds, one simple thought never quite went away: what if I didn’t just adventure with these creatures—what if I could really meet them, understand them, even become them, and see the world the way they do?

That thought became the seed for everything: a vast open-world adventure across Idyll, a story of exploration that takes you from the touch of a paw to the heart of the world. In the beginning, all we built was a world for the Aniimo to live in. But as we kept creating, ideas started springing up out of that world on their own. Their families, their quirks, how they got along with each other, all their odd little behaviors. Piece by piece, it all took shape. And sometimes, the strangest feeling would creep in: it didn’t feel like we were designing these Aniimo anymore. It felt like we were discovering them. The Emberpups who trail devotedly after their leader. The Nimbis drifting lazily over the grasslands. The Susutas who pile onto the beach to play in crowds. As each one came into focus, we’d catch ourselves thinking: of course. That’s exactly what they’re supposed to be like. That's why we love Aniimo.

The joy was never just in inventing creature after creature—it was in walking through a world like Idyll and finding them there, one step at a time. Stumbling onto a family you’d never met, an Aniimo you’d never seen. Noticing the funny relationships between them, realizing this world is so full of stories. That joy of discovery is what we want to pass on to you. We hope that when you set foot in Idyll, you’ll start with your own footsteps and eventually leave paw prints no one else could leave. And to everyone who’s ever dreamed of adventuring alongside creatures as wondrous as the Aniimo: Idyll is waiting, and so are the encounters meant for you.

The Core Experience of Aniimo

So what kind of game is Aniimo, really? For those of you about to set foot in Idyll for the first time, we’d like to take this chance to introduce the adventure that awaits you there.

Everyone who comes to Idyll becomes a "Pathfinder," gaining an incredibly unique ability. Because here, you don’t just have an Aniimo. You can become one. By establishing bonds and twining with Aniimo, you’ll not only fight at their side and unravel the world’s mysteries, you’ll also actually join their families, and come to know the stories playing out between them. And most importantly, you can step into an Aniimo’s point of view—seeing the whole continent again through their eyes, their wings, their senses.

All across Idyll, countless Aniimo of every form, temperament, and habit live freely, each with their own families and their own way of life. When you meet them, we hope you’ll see more than something to put in the index. We hope you’ll see a life that actually belongs here. That’s why the journey at the heart of Aniimo was never about grinding stages and ticking off a checklist. It’s about walking into a living, breathing world and writing your own stories alongside the creatures who call it home.

Where does the journey end? That’s an answer we’d rather leave to each Pathfinder. Perhaps you’ll become the professor who’s cataloged every Aniimo, or perhaps the undisputed champion of Aniimo battles. Perhaps you’ll become Idyll’s greatest treasure hunter, a master gardener, a home design genius... How you play and who you become are entirely up to you. Our story begins the moment palm meets paw print.

Your Words Genuinely Changed Aniimo

From the very first sketches of Idyll, we wanted Aniimo to be an adventure we finished together with our players. Every test has been a chance for us to see the game with new eyes, for you to discover new content and systems, and for us to take a hard look at what we’d built.

When the most recent test wrapped up, we went through everything carefully: the praise and the anticipation, and the blunt, unsparing criticism too. We want the changes themselves to prove a point: what you said didn’t just sit in forums, group chats, and feedback forms. Here’s some of what has already landed in the launch version.

  • The Irisalis Catching Experience

    [/*]

In earlier tests, many Pathfinders who met Irisalis told us the same story: throwing ball after ball got dull fast, and stacking the entry cost and repeated throws on top of pure luck turned a legendary encounter into a draining chore. Looking back, we saw the problem clearly. We’d hoped randomness would make meeting a Legendary Aniimo feel like a challenge—but we’d overlooked some players’ experiences, and this repetitiveness made the experience less immersive of what we set out to create.

For launch, we’ve redesigned the entire process of obtaining Irisalis around three things: how you reach it, how it plays, and how the encounter itself feels. This design will be the template for every Legendary Aniimo encounter to come.

How you reach it: No more repeating the challenge in the hope of a successful catch. Collect legendary tokens through world exploration and story progress, craft your own personal Legendary Aniipod, and unlock Irisalis’s exclusive story.

How it plays: Token collecting is incorporated into everyday exploration and catching, so progress builds naturally as you adventure.

How the encounter feels: Once your Legendary Aniipod is crafted, the exclusive encounter appears on the map. Enter the battle, follow the story, defeat the Legendary Aniimo, and throw the Aniipod you made to seal your bond with Irisalis. This encounter only happens once, so make it count.

  • Changes to Acquiring and Encountering Prismana Aniimo

    [/*]

The base chance of triggering Prismana Aniimo through nurturing is now flat, removing the early-game probability decay from low Prismatic Energy (every nurturing now has the same chance of triggering Prismana Flow). The guarantee system remains.

A new lucky strike mechanic has been added to catching. Lucky strikes grant item rewards, increase the area’s Prismatic Energy, and have a chance to directly trigger Prismana Flow, attracting Prismana Aniimo.

Wild Surges triggered through ecosystem nurturing now offer a chance to encounter Umbral Aniimo, who have Perfect Potential and distinctive coloration. Umbral Aniimo can also be encountered by chance in the open world.

Offering quality no longer affects Wild Surge quality. Ecosystem nurturing now grants a fixed amount of Prismatic Energy.

Spawn rules for season-exclusive Prismana Aniimo have been reworked, with clearer, more intuitive trigger conditions.

  • Easier Aniimo Training

    [/*]

The Carried Item system has been simplified: random rune slots are gone, and the rune system has been removed entirely.

Legendary Star Dust output has been increased. Capability Awakening for Aniimo below Lv. 60 can now be reset at any time, with the training items returned.

Capability caps now unlock gradually with Aniimo level and Resonance star rank, easing early progression pressure.

Capafruit effects now transfer automatically between Aniimo during inheritance, so switching which Aniimo you raise no longer requires the same investment all over again.

  • Home Improvements

    [/*]

The RV upgrade experience has been improved, with adjusted upgrade times to ease resource shortages after upgrades.

The Home has expanded into a multi-area map with house building and a large selection of new furniture. Interior decorating will continue to be improved.

Order refresh logic has been improved, with more order variety.

Furniture groups can now be shared via codes, and multi-select limits have been raised.

New interactive furniture has been added, and some pieces can now be placed and used out in the open world.

Home Aniimo have new idle AI behaviors, improved work logic, and a new petting interaction.

Unused furniture can be sold back at a discount through the Co-op Store.

RV dispatches now have a chance to produce Aniimo eggs with the Prismana trait.

New Home season events offer season-exclusive furniture and formulas.

New soil-tilling social interaction: till the soil at another Pathfinder’s Home to earn a share of their harvest.

  • Other Improvements

    [/*]

Improved controls on mobile devices and with controllers.

Multi-language voiceover added to the main story, with improved translation quality across all languages.

Aniimo caught with a Sparkling Cube now have guaranteed Perfect Potential.

Operation: Egg Heist has been substantially improved, with more obtainable egg types and a new high-difficulty Chaos Mode. PvP event modes will continue to be refined.

Spawn rates for high-Potential 9/9 and 10/10 wild Aniimo have been increased.

Journey quest guidance has been rebuilt, fixing vague requirements and progression blockers.

New Pathfinder Challenge rematches, plus AI teammate support for Holo-Battle Interlink.

The player character’s look has been refined, alongside improved NPC models, animations, and expressions.

A New Invitation

Through every test, you’ve spoken up. And whether it came as criticism or encouragement, every word you’ve shared has been precious to us. In what you’ve told us, we’ve come to see your standards for quality, your love and support for Aniimo, as well as your doubts and disappointments. So in the days ahead, we hope you’ll keep telling us what you think and what you hope for. If Aniimo is going to become a genuinely great game, it can’t be built on the dev team’s judgment alone. To help Aniimo thrive, we need to work together with everyone who loves the game. We hope Aniimo becomes more than a game to you. We hope it becomes a way of life you can truly look forward to.

Thank you all.

Aniimo shines brighter because of you, Pathfinders!

May we meet in Idyll.

Pawprint Studio

Ahead of Aniimo’s launch, 2026
